title: Curses and Blessings from Gerizim and Ebal
description: Moses commands that the tribes be divided into two groups when they cross the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph and Benjamin are to stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, while Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali are to stand on Mount Ebal and pronounce the curse. The Levites then proclaim twelve curses in a loud voice against those who break God’s commands—from idolatry and dishonoring parents to injustice toward foreigners, sexual offenses, violence and bribery—and all the people answer "Amen" after each curse.
